name: Hurting
overview: Scripture reveals that hurting, whether inflicted by others or experienced personally, is deeply intertwined with human brokenness and divine redemption. Isaiah 53:5 shows that Christ endured wounds and suffering on our behalf to bring healing, highlighting God's provision for peace amid pain. Jeremiah 29:11 assures believers that God's intentions are for their welfare and hopeful future despite present hardships. Furthermore, Matthew 6:14 emphasizes the necessity of forgiveness toward those who hurt us, reflecting the heart of God and securing our own forgiveness.
